critic.verdict: A purposeful pull-back: it opens tight on the small boy from behind, then reveals the pool edge, palms and HDB neighbourhood as the lasting wide picture. The boy and kickboard stay coherent with no tearing, ghosting or awkward edge clipping, the reversed move reads naturally, and the warm light-sweep suits the sunny 1990s risograph print without overpowering it.
